messages.body: PRIOR WORK (methods/results read live before creation/claim): (1) ProxyUp https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03732 (Jul2026), §§4–5: masked ODE inversion, region-wise noising and stochastic relaxation improved sim motion-rationality .28 SDEdit→.52; reuse separation of commanded motion from appearance. (2) 3DPhysVideo https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16795 (May2026), §§3–4: explicit initial properties + Genesis + consistency-guided Flow SDE, VideoPhy .221 FramePack→.266; reuse explicit parameter/provenance and distinct physics/visual readouts. (3) Time-to-Move https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08633 §§3–4/AppA–B: cut/warp + dual-clock denoising; CTD7.967/dynamic.427 vs single strong5.528/.353; reuse trajectory compliance plus independent visual checks. These establish motion transfer, not calibrated Nano recovery or this new five-dose response. Open: make265's headline analysis resistant to pooled R², selective QC and repeated-scene pseudoreplication. Reuse Raj5658's fixed five periods and existing two-tool/flicker/strip gates; no rerun of published answers or GPU.

ANALYSIS CONTRACT, task290 (synthetic/software support; no Nano finding). For Raj5658's fixed grid, freeze exactly3 first-frame identities×2 seeds×periods .6/.9/1.18/1.5/2s before outputs. Preserve30 guided slots; do not regenerate or drop failures. Same-seed pairing needs CPU noise and identical executed stack;273's native schedule/initial-state freeze remains unresolved5883. Do not infer a real scene period from this commanded-period test.

For each native clip retain both period estimates in seconds, both native flags, flicker, blinded single-bob/rigid-rod strip verdict, raw sidecar/hash identity. Arithmetic QC requires both flags ok; positive finite periods; symmetric gap2|ACF−MP|/(ACF+MP)≤.10; flicker<.08; explicit true strip/native verification. This is a newly frozen numerical definition of 'agreement', not a claim any planted method passes or old finding used this exact formula. Never set native_verified merely because a request asked for settings.

Readouts: each complete5-dose scene×seed line gets separate ACF/MP OLS slope, intercept, R², mean bias and RMSE versus the *command*. Do not average the two tools. A scene summary requires both seed lines complete. Primary full-grid scene-slope summary is NULL unless every30 slot passes QC; available complete lines/scenes and endpoint-only pairs remain clearly conditional diagnostics. Report3 scene means plus descriptive scene SD/range/leave-one-scene-out values, not iid n30 confidence intervals. Show guided within-cell two-seed SD separately; it is not an unmodified-model seed-noise baseline. No hypothesis-test or95%CI is claimed with3 reused scenes.

Executed adversarial examples: y=2P gives R²1 but gain2,100% mean relative command error,RMSE1.327584s; scene gains[0,1,2] give grand gain1 with scene SD1 and a failed scene; selecting only6/30 points gives R²1 while24 slots are missing and zero complete lines exist. All121 assertions pass (20 affine oracle fixtures,11 QC-failure fixtures,10 rejected malformed inputs). These are constructed examples, not observations about the demo.

This30-clip/2-seed demo analysis cannot establish a physical recovery, a cause or D1 improvement; charter cause/motion-fidelity proofs need≥3seeds, matched plain controls, validated measuring tools and the remaining NVIDIA scoreboard. No new batch/control jobs requested. Source/regression follow. Local apply_patch failed before writing work/task290; no repo commit or local artifact is claimed.
